text:
tara: Heads-up — during the nightly node drain we saw the DCGM exporter restart repeatedly on 3 nodes and flood the prometheus scrape logs. Root cause looks like exporter receiving SIGTERM then immediately getting restarted by the sidecar restart policy.
ben: ugh. that's churn and alert spam. did the drain send a graceful shutdown? we should be quiescing metrics before PID 1 exits.
priya: I skimmed logs. exporter writes 'received SIGTERM, shutting down' then within 300ms kubelet restarts the container because the sidecar probe swings to failing. probe config is liveness only right now.
noah: we rely on liveness for crash detection. For drains the better pattern is readiness to false + delay, then terminate. We should add a preStop hook to set readiness=false and sleep 5s to let queued scrapes settle.
ben: makes sense. Also saw high-cardinality spikes for exporter_gpus_memory_.* labels when jobs migrated. Might be stale per-device labels reappearing during restart.
priya: yeah that explains prometheus series churn. If exporter restarts quickly prometheus sees new series with short relabel fingerprints. We can reduce scrape frequency during drains or have exporter expose an endpoint to quiesce and drop ephemeral labels.
tara: proposal:
- add `/-/quiesce` HTTP endpoint on exporter that sets readiness=false, flushes ephemeral metrics, and returns 200
- preStop hook: curl -sfS http://localhost:9100/-/quiesce || true; sleep 8
- change liveness probe to be less aggressive (initialDelay 10s, period 10s)
- rollout as canary to 5% of nodes
noah: I like that. low-risk. can we implement quiesce without big code change? maybe check env var to disable by default.
priya: I can whip a tiny patch in the exporter binary to listen on /-/quiesce and set an in-memory flag to filter per-gpu ephemeral labels for the next 15s. Also ensure it flushes stale label sets via a short GC.
ben: add unit tests and an e2e that simulates `kubectl drain` to ensure no restart storm and no new series created.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: new image pushed: gcr.io/redwood/dcgm-exporter:quiesce-20260311
tara: great. schedule a slow canary tonight. I'll update the helm chart with preStop and probe changes and put a note in the rollout channel.
priya: quick config snippet for helm (will PR):
```
livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /metrics
    port: 9100
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 10
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /metrics
    port: 9100
preStop:
  exec:
    command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "curl -fsS http://localhost:9100/-/quiesce || true; sleep 8"]
```
noah: add a Prometheus alert tweak too: suppress exporter-restarts alerts tied to nodes in Cordon/Drain state (label node: condition="draining"). That'll avoid noisy pager.
ben: agree. also add a runbook line: if exporter restart storm happens -> cordon node -> check preStop invocation and grace period.
tara: PRs: one for exporter code, one for helm change, one for alert rule. I'll tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
priya: I'll also add a small metric `exporter_quiesced_total` so we can track if preStop actually called.
infra-bot: cicd-bot: canary rollout scheduled to 5 nodes at 02:30 UTC
ben: thanks everyone. follow-up tomorrow to see scrape series delta in grafana. :eyes:
